entities.name: Cisco
entities.gloss: An American multinational digital communications technology and networking hardware conglomerate.

entities.name: Cisco Discovery Protocol
entities.gloss: A proprietary Data Link Layer network protocol developed by Cisco to discover network devices.

entities.name: CDPwn
entities.gloss: A collective name for five high-severity security vulnerabilities affecting the Cisco Discovery Protocol implementation.

entities.name: CVE-2020-3120
entities.gloss: A denial of service vulnerability in Cisco FXOS, IOS XR, and NX-OS CDP implementation.

entities.name: Cisco FXOS
entities.gloss: A network operating system developed by Cisco for Firepower security appliances.

entities.name: Cisco IOS XR
entities.gloss: A train of Cisco Systems' fully modular network operating systems used on high-end routers.

entities.name: Cisco NX-OS
entities.gloss: A network operating system for the Nexus-series Ethernet switches and MDS-series Fibre Channel switches.

entities.name: CVE-2020-3119
entities.gloss: A stack overflow and remote code execution vulnerability in Cisco NX-OS CDP implementation.

entities.name: CVE-2020-3118
entities.gloss: A stack overflow and remote code execution vulnerability in Cisco IOS XR CDP implementation.

entities.name: CVE-2020-3111
entities.gloss: A remote code execution and denial of service vulnerability in Cisco IP Phone CDP implementation.

entities.name: IP-телефон Cisco IP
entities.gloss: Voice over IP (VoIP) telephony hardware manufactured by Cisco.

entities.name: CVE-2020-3110
entities.gloss: A remote code execution and denial of service vulnerability in Cisco Video Surveillance 8000 Series IP Cameras.

entities.name: IP-камери Cisco для відеоспостереження серії 8000
entities.gloss: A line of high-definition video surveillance IP cameras manufactured by Cisco.
